claims.disproof_condition: 條件：模組廠或 DSP 廠的一手寫出 LRO 的發送端改由主機端 SerDes 直接驅動、模組內不再放 DSP（等於變成 LPO），並成為該世代主流。核查頻率：每半年（OFC、OCP 與模組廠年報）。觸發後 48 小時：e1（tech:lro depends_on tech:optical_module_dsp）加註世代範圍或提撤回；重讀光模組 DSP 層的需求側。
claims.statement: Credo press release (2023-11-29) introducing the Dove 850 800G DSP 'optimized for Linear Receive Optics (LRO), also known within the industry as Half-retimed Linear Optics (HALO)': 'In an LRO transceiver or Active Optical Cable (AOC), only the transmit path from the electrical input to the optical line side output includes a DSP for signal retiming and equalization.' LRO therefore still needs a transmit-side optical module DSP — roughly half of a fully retimed design. A DSP vendor's own architectural description.

source_doc.permission_basis: 公司官網公開新聞稿；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取 dateline「SAN JOSE, Calif.—Nov. 29, 2023」（頁面 JSON-LD datePublished 同日）；IR 站 PDF 版同文。
source_doc.title: Credo 新聞稿（2023-11-29）〈Credo Introduces World’s First 800G DSP for Linear Receive Optics, Targeting Hyperscale and AI Data Centers〉：Dove 850 為 LRO（亦稱 HALO）設計；LRO 只有發送路徑含 DSP

sources.quote: optimized for Linear Receive Optics (LRO), also known within the industry as Half-retimed Linear Optics (HALO).
In an LRO transceiver or Active Optical Cable (AOC), only the transmit path from the electrical input to the optical line side output includes a DSP for signal retiming and equalization.
